programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. "Monsters and Mysteries in America" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Bringing you the best in entertainment. We explore the lives of nature's wildest animals from all corners of the world, and see how they have learned to adapt, both to survive and to evolve.

programme.title: Secret Ways
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the various secrets methods of survival of different animal species, highlighting their ways of scavenging food and protecting their offsprings.

programme.title: Fear on the Savannah
programme.desc: Authorities introduced lions in a rehabilitated national park where only herbivores lived, and fear overtook the park.

programme.title: Earth: A Wild Refuge
programme.desc: Showcasing the most remote and astonishing corners of the world, from majestic whales to graceful penguins and the imposing force of volcanoes, revealing the diversity of life on Earth.

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.desc: Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Wild By Nature
programme.desc: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth.
